title: [Decision] #25919 PR 2: the ruled 10 KB `ui/AGENTS.md` core cannot also hold every ⛔/never line verbatim (those lines alone are 16.8 KB) — which half of the ruling gives way?
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVyH9FzSkzAGmz8LNE

Filing gate ②: a decision only the maintainer can make. It arose while executing ruling 6435359095 (letter A, PR 2 of #25919) under the standing ruling 6407900763 items 1–2. Two of that ruling's own parameters cannot both hold. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023) · `sunhaolin` · `session_017xRBcVyH9FzSkzAGmz8LNE`. ⛔ Not a claim. Under the protocol, a question born while executing a ruling goes on a new card, and the ruled card #25919 does not get `needs-user-decision` again. #25919 moves to `pm:blocked` behind this card in the same sequence.

**Business reason.** Every agent session that works in `ui/` loads `ui/AGENTS.md` (36,089 bytes) as mandatory context, and the file carries false instructions. The restructure that fixes both is ruled and approved, but it cannot start: whichever half a dev gives up, the PR fails the ruling, and the maintainer's approval is spent on a PR that has to be redone.
**Reader who acts:** the director seat presents this card. After the ruling, the `domain:devx` seat dispatches #25919 PR 2 with the chosen letter.
**Dedupe:** REST list of all 2,037 `domain:devx` issues (open and closed), titles grepped for `ui/AGENTS|10 ?KB|core-rules|verbatim|narrative cost`. Hits: #25919 (the parent), #25712 (closed; it nested `ui/AGENTS.md` and did not size it), and 7 unrelated `verbatim` cards. Positive control: 24 titles name `AGENTS.md`. The open `needs-user-decision` box (5 cards) has no hit. The search API is not available from this seat, so the scan is limited to the `domain:devx` label plus the open box.

## 维护者速读

你在 #25919 上裁了 A：`ui/AGENTS.md` 改成「规范核心 ≤10 KB」，其余章节原样搬到专题页；附带条件是「每条 ⛔ / never 规则原样留在核心里」。实测这两条装不下：⛔/never 共 27 行，光这 27 行就有 16,789 字节，已经超过 10 KB。整行保留，核心约 20 KB；只抽句子也要约 13 KB，同样超限。PR 2 因此无法开工。请在两者之间选一个让步：**A** 保留「⛔ 规则全在核心」，放弃 10 KB 这个数（核心约 20 KB，仍比现在少约一半）；**B** 保留 10 KB，⛔ 规则可以随专题页原样搬走，核心只留每页一行指针；**C** 把句子从原行里拆出来，上限放到约 13 KB。席位推荐 **A**。

## Governing text

- Ruling 6407900763 item 1 (letter A, maintainer 「13455 A」): "`AGENTS.md` … becomes a core-rules file of at most 10 KB", and in the same item "Condition (triage 6385702437, kept): every ⛔ and "never" rule stays in the core verbatim". The two are the subject of this card.
- Ruling 6435359095 (letter A for PR 2, 「批 #408  同意」): dispatch PR 2 under items 1–2; "Not … C (symptom only)". So the stale-claims-only fix is not offered again here.
- The mother ruling cloud#3194 → A (6385321890) is where the 10 KB figure comes from: it was sized for cloud's own `AGENTS.md`. 6407900651 carried it over to objectui as an "execution parameter of the same letter". That carry-over is a seat's reading. The maintainer has not ruled on it.
- Root `AGENTS.md` and its line ratchet are not this card's subject.

**Protocol statement.** `Metadata-protocol: none`. No spec, no metadata contract, no runtime capability. The surface is governed rule text (Tier H), so the PR lands only by the maintainer's approval after a contract review.

## Premises (read at `origin/main` `6dbff8e20a`, 2026-10-28T15:21Z)

1. `ui/AGENTS.md` is 36,089 bytes over 261 lines. Re-check: `git show origin/main:ui/AGENTS.md | wc -c -l`.
2. 27 lines carry ⛔ or "never" (18 ⛔, 20 case-insensitive "never"), together 16,789 bytes. Re-check: `git show origin/main:ui/AGENTS.md | grep -ci -E '⛔|never'` and `… | grep -i -E '⛔|never' | wc -c`. Positive control on the same file: `… | grep -c pnpm` → 20.
3. A whole-line core is about 20 KB, and a sentence-only lift is about 13 KB. These are the released card thread's estimates in 6455483141, at `beb09fb2`. This seat re-measured only premise 2's 16,789-byte floor; the 20 KB and 13 KB figures are 未实测 here. The file has not changed since then: its last touch is `3d50a43bc` (2026-10-26).
4. The ruling's line-222 premise is wrong in part (6455483141 item 2). Root `packages/console/dist` is real; only the `:3001` port claim is stale. The other stale claims are listed in 6455483141 item 3. They ride PR 2 under every letter.

## Options

| Letter | What PR 2 does | What the customer (an agent in `ui/`) gets | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Every ⛔/never line stays in the core whole and verbatim. The 10 KB figure is dropped, and the core's size becomes whatever those lines plus one pointer line per topic page come to. Everything else moves verbatim. | Mandatory context drops from 36 KB to about 20 KB (未实测), and every hard prohibition is still read on every session. | devx · 1 Tier H PR + contract review · M · no precedent in this repo for a core restructure (PR 1 #26023 was +27/−2,177 housekeeping) |
| **B** | The 10 KB cap stays. ⛔/never lines may move verbatim with their sections to the topic pages. The core keeps one pointer line per page, and the 27-line census is kept across core plus pages. | About 10 KB of mandatory context. A prohibition that moved is read only when the agent opens that page. | same, M |
| **C** | Sentences are lifted out of their lines into the core, about 13 KB, and the cap is raised to that. The remainder of each line moves to a topic page. | About 13 KB. Each split bullet now lives in two places, and the core sentence loses the context its line gave it. | same, M+, because each split must be shown not to reword |

**业务含义直译。** A = 员工手册保留全部「红线」条款，只把案例故事挪到附录。B = 手册只剩目录，红线散在各附录里，没翻到那页的人就不知道。C = 把每条红线从原段落里剪出来贴进手册，原段落留个残句在附录。

## 四维分析

- **① 项目长远合理性（领起）：** 核心文件存在的意义，就是让每个会话都必然读到全部硬性禁令。27 条 ⛔ 的普查才是要守的不变量；10 KB 是从 cloud 那份文件借来的尺寸，不是为 `ui/` 推导出来的数。A 守住不变量，而且一次到位；B 守住了数字，却丢了不变量；C 两头都不完整，还在每条拆开的条目上留下双份维护。
- **② 实际业务拉动：** 今天每个 `ui/` 车道会话都要加载 36 KB，其中有已证伪的指令（`plugin-msw`、`registry.ts`、`:3001`）。A 砍掉约 45%，并修掉这些错误；B 再多省约 10 KB；C 多省约 7 KB。这一点上 A、B 都有收益，差距只是 token 量。
- **③ 防 AI 写错：** 选 B，只读核心的 agent 会在毫无提示的情况下违反一条搬走的 ⛔ 规则：违反是静默的，复审才可能发现。选 A，规则始终在必读上下文里，违反属于明知故犯，可以响亮地拒收。C 剪下来的句子丢了限定语，agent 照字面执行，可能比原文管得更宽或更窄。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散：** 三个选项都只删减文字，不新增门禁（PR 里的普查前后计数手工跑，沿用 6407900763 item 2「no gate」）。A 不引入新的数字约束要守，最省后续义务。

os-decision-facets
① 长远：A 守 ⛔ 普查这个真不变量，一次付清；B 守的是借来的数字；C 两头不全，留下双份维护
② 拉动：每个 ui 会话加载 36 KB 且含已证伪指令；A 砍约 45%，B、C 多省的只是 token
③ 防错：B 让搬走的 ⛔ 规则静默失效；A 让规则恒在必读上下文；C 剪句后丢失限定语
④ 不扩散：三者都只删字、不加门禁；A 不新增需要长期守的数字
Prior rulings read: core,verbatim,10 kb,never → 164 hits; ADR-0076 D1, ADR-0130 D2, ADR-0002–0005 (term matches only, none rules on an instruction-file size); thread: 2 ruling(s) on #25919 (6407900763, 6435359095), whose own item 1 holds both prescriptions; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**A.** End state: two years on, the `ui/` instruction set is a core that holds every hard prohibition once, each with its instrument pointer, plus topic pages for procedure and incident history. The invariant worth keeping is "every never is read on every session". A byte count is a proxy for that, and here it was borrowed from another file. Not B: it keeps a borrowed number and gives up the invariant the number was meant to approximate. Not C: it splits lines, which fits badly with the same ruling's "no sentence reworded", and it doubles the upkeep on every split line.

- **Confidence gap:** the about-20 KB size of an A core is the released thread's estimate, 未实测 by this seat. The dev measures it before editing and reports it. A number far above that would be a reason to re-present, and it would not change the letter.
- **Self-check:** 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否 (② favours B only on token count; ③④ agree with A).

## After the ruling

- The devx seat moves #25919 from `pm:blocked` to `pm:queue` and dispatches PR 2 under 6435359095. The ruling's item-1 cap parameter is replaced by this card's letter, cited on a `Ruling-ref:` line.
- The PR shows the 27-line census before and after, uses `git diff --color-moved` for the moves, and carries 6455483141's stale-claim fixes. It also edits `scripts/check-agent-test-spelling.mjs` `COUNTER_EXAMPLE_FILES` if the trap-two bullet moves (6455483141 item 4).
- Tier H: contract review first, then the maintainer's approval. A seat never approves it.

Related: #25919 · 6407900763 · 6435359095 · 6455483141 · 6433987592 · #25712 · PR #26023.
